{{Quote|Welcome, welcome! Browse and delight at the menagerie of values to be found among Surik Varr's Sundries and Esoterica!|Surik Varr|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Surik Varr's Sundries and Esoterica''' was a small thrift shop run out of a stall at the [[House Traders' Circle|House Trader's Circle]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. Run by [[Surik Varr]], it was actually a front for Varr's work as an agent of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]].
